# entrepot_repositories (Data Source)

Lists the repositories the provider's credentials can read, optionally of one format.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "entrepot_repositories" "docker" {
  format = "docker"
}

output "docker_repository_urls" {
  value = { for r in data.entrepot_repositories.docker.repositories : r.name => r.url }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `format` (String) Only list repositories of this format (`raw`, `pypi`, `npm`, `docker`, `apt`, `yum`, `helm`).

### Read-Only

- `names` (List of String) Names of the listed repositories, in the same order as `repositories`.
- `repositories` (Attributes List) The repositories. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--repositories))

<a id="nestedatt--repositories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `repositories`

Read-Only:

- `anonymous_read` (Boolean) Whether unauthenticated reads are allowed.
- `blob_store` (String) Blob store holding the repository's content.
- `format` (String) Repository format.
- `kind` (String) `hosted`, `proxy` or `group`.
- `name` (String) Repository name.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether the repository is online.
- `url` (String) URL to configure package clients with.
